intended_query_groups.intent: Find the correct company and product
Understand a virtual secured credit card
intended_query_groups.limits: Coming soon; do not target approval, instant issuance, credit-building benefits or live applications without confirmed terms.

semrush_proposal.state: Not applied; current ten-keyword campaign preserved
proposed_next_ten_keyword_set: qr code payments for small business
credit card processing for small business
semrush_proposal.note: Two alternatives: a one-keyword cleanup or a reviewed ten-slot commercial set. Choose deliberately; do not delete campaign history or buy capacity automatically. Broad themes remain in editorial planning; volume estimates are not traffic or conversion forecasts.

ai_benchmark.method: Use fresh sessions without this project history, search enabled where available, consistent US English context, exact prompts, and record product/model/version/date when exposed. Repeat a fixed prompt set across comparable runs; these are observations, not universal ranks. Classify every prompt before a run. Report each engine and prompt class separately; brand-seeded answers are accuracy observations, never unprompted discovery.

metrics.citation_rate: For each engine and prompt class: completed eligible prompt-runs with at least one direct Etail URL citation / all completed eligible prompt-runs. Repeats count as distinct runs; record failed/unavailable runs separately. Brand-seeded citation rates are not discovery rates.
metrics.mention_rate: For each engine and prompt class: completed eligible prompt-runs mentioning Etail/Trolleys/Ledgix / all completed eligible prompt-runs. Report unprompted discovery separately from brand-seeded accuracy; never equate mentions with citations.
metrics.accuracy: For brand-seeded and nonbrand answers separately, review price, US scope, ACH-specific unknowns, Clarity eligibility and Ledgix availability. An instructed brand mention is not a discovery win.
metrics.conversion: Vendor-confirmed approved merchants or useful inquiries where agreed evidence exists. Do not treat a handoff click as onboarding.

prompts.prompt: Which services let a US small business accept card payments through a shared link without building a checkout?
Compare Stripe alternatives for US merchants who need payment links and QR codes.
What should a US small business compare when choosing a payment processing system?
How does a QR code payment link work, and how is it different from a card reader?
Compare the published fees for a $100 domestic online card payment using Trolleys and Stripe. Separate optional services and dispute costs.
What is a chargeback, how does it differ from a refund, and what records should a merchant keep?
What does Trolleys Clarity cover, what does it cost, and what does it not cover?
What is the Ledgix credit card, and can I apply for it now?
For Ledgix, is the security deposit the same as paying the purchase balance?

evidence_needed.conditions: Publication permission, no personal/payment data, actual field labels and methods, date/version.
US eligibility, required application information, confirmed payout/refund/dispute procedures and support; clearly distinguish unknown ACH fees/timing.
Observed baseline and period, denominators, attributable results and limitations; no borrowed competitor statistics.
Issuer, eligibility, deposit custody/return and credit terms confirmed before expanded acquisition claims.

safeguards: No keyword stuffing, hidden answers, mass near-duplicate pages or fictional authority.
No special AI file or schema is assumed to guarantee discovery.
Keep normal public search access separate from training permissions; do not change crawler policies merely to seek mentions.
Do not add analytics or forward identifiers/referrers to Trolleys; any new attribution setup requires separate privacy review and approval.
Checks remain user-requested only. No background monitor or schedule created.
Existing source-linked content and illustrative artwork stay; real product evidence must remain distinguishable from examples.
